newsitem.title: PANAMA: SOCCER-PANAMA CONFIRM MUNOZ AS NEW COACH.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-PANAMA CONFIRM MUNOZ AS NEW COACH.

text.p: Panama have named Orlando Munoz as their new coach, soccer officials confirmed on Friday.
Munoz, who until now was the side's physical trainer, replaces Colombian Cesar Maturana, sacked this week after a poor series of World Cup qualifying results.
Munoz, who was linked to the job by Panamanian TV on Thursday, is contracted until December 15, when the CONCACAF semifinal round ends.
In their three World Cup matches to date, Panama lost 3-1 to both Canada and Cuba before drawing 1-1 against El Salvador.
